programme.title: Jellyfish - The Ocean's New Rulers
programme.desc: Jellyfish have been around for more than 500 million years. They don't have a heart, a brain or a skeleton, and are 90 percent water. But the damage they're able to inflict often makes the headlines.

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: E34
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E34
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: The General's Daughter

As Rhian uncovers the truth about her origins, she finds herself torn between loyalty to the family that raised her and her duty to justice, leading to a dangerous conflict involving family, betrayal, and redemption

programme.title: E9 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂！

programme.title: E61
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E35
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taipei. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Chan Hing Kai
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him...
